description: Turn a plain-words need into steps (one trigger + actions) and pick the concrete tool for each step from 3,000+ app capabilities (n8n nodes, OpenAPI, MCP). Reports a gap when the named app cannot do a step instead of substituting another app.

alternatives.description: Runner-up tools to list per step (1-5).

need.description: What should happen, in plain words: 'when <trigger> <action>, then <action>'.

name: plan_automation

steps.description: trigger + actions, each with the best tool, alternatives, or a gap

items.description: One step: text, kind (trigger/action), the chosen tool or a gap; reversibility = read-only (changes nothing) / reversible (undo by hand) / irreversible (sends, posts, deletes, pays — out in the world), and approval_gate (an Approve/Decline message runs first).

title: Plan an automation (tool per step)
